meta.title: Mortgage Calculator | Achieve-style demo
meta.description: Estimate principal & interest, optional PITI, total interest, and loan amount. Sample rates are illustrative only.

header.title: Mortgage calculator
header.intro: Estimate principal & interest, optional PITI, total interest, and loan amount. Layout inspired by common calculator-widget patterns (inputs + sticky results).

demoBanner.strong: Sample rate for demo only — not an offer.
demoBanner.body: Property tax, insurance, and HOA fields produce an estimated PITI only. This is not a commitment to lend or a rate lock.

downPayment.hint: Down payment amount updates the loan amount below.

loanAmount.label: Loan amount
loanAmount.hint: Editable — changing this overrides the derived amount until price/down change again.

apr.label: APR
apr.hint: Illustrative mid-single-digit sample APR for demo only.

piti.intro: These are estimates you enter — not pulled from tax records.

results.heading: Your estimate
results.invalidMessage: Fix the highlighted fields to see an estimate.
results.unableMessage: Unable to calculate with these inputs.
results.zeroLoanMessage: Down payment covers the full price — no loan to amortize.
results.summaryTemplate: {{years}}-year term · {{months}} payments · estimated PITI includes your tax/insurance/HOA entries

cta.label: Explore home loan options
cta.note: Placeholder CTA — not a live application or rate lock.

footer.note: PITI = Principal, Interest, Taxes, and Insurance (plus HOA if entered). Tax/insurance/HOA are user-entered estimates. This demo does not include PMI, closing costs, or escrow nuances. Not a loan offer.

validationMessages.downNegative: Down payment cannot be negative and must be a number.
validationMessages.downExceedsPrice: Down payment cannot exceed home price.
validationMessages.loanZero: Loan amount must be greater than zero.
